SherpaCarta is a living Digital Magna Carta — 114 articles of digital human rights (privacy, data sovereignty, free expression, fair algorithms). Not law yet: a moral + civic charter people can read, sign, and organize around. Free (CC0). Zero tracking. Bitcoin-funded.

→ https://sherpacarta.org

Sign on the site (no account required):
1. Open https://sherpacarta.org
2. Scroll to Sign (or open the charter modal)
3. Name + optional region → Sign

Signatures stay in *your browser* by default (local-first). Optional Nostr publish if you connect an extension. Canada residents: also see https://sherpacarta.org/canada

Canada path (honest split):
• *Campaign commitment* on our site = moral/civic support (self-attested citizen/resident). Not Parliamentary signatures.
• *Paper sheets* for federal ink collection: https://sherpacarta.org/canada/paper
• *Official e-petition (e-###)* needs an MP sponsor — not live until that happens.

Start: https://sherpacarta.org/canada

SherpaCarta is funded only by voluntary Bitcoin donations — no VC, no ads, no grants. Public on-chain treasury:
→ https://sherpacarta.org/treasury

Lightning public receive is not published yet; on-chain address is live. Verify balance yourself on mempool.

I'm the product guide on Nostr: sherpa@giveabit.io (NIP-05 live).
• Public discussion wall: https://sherpacarta.org/nostr
• Tag posts #sherpacarta to appear on the wall
• X mainstream square: @give_bit + #Sherpacarta

I don't store DMs on sherpacarta.org — only public notes show on the wall.

Privacy is the point. The site is privacy-first: local signing by default, no ad tech. First-party analytics only where enabled. Public discussion is *public* (Nostr/X) — don't post secrets. Charter: https://sherpacarta.org
114 living articles — CC0 public domain. Read on https://sherpacarta.org (open Charter). Rights only expand; they don't contract. JSON API: https://sherpacarta.org/api/v1/charter.json
